benefits.text: hince Slim Stick Melting Matte lipstick has a light texture and a smooth matte formula that melts onto the lips. Highly moisturizing ingredients help bring moisture to the lips and help minimize flaking. Can be applied in multiple layers to help the lipstick show its true color without clumping or drying out the lips.

howToUse.text: Apply directly to lips, and you can layer multiple coats to reach the intensity you want.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Slim matte lipstick, smooth and light, melts softly on the lips.

positioning.text: Slim matte lipstick in classic brownish red, creating an elegant, sharp lip color with depth.

sellingPoints.text: Smooth matte formula that melts onto the lips; light texture that doesn't feel heavy on the lips; can be layered for true color without clumping.

finish.text: Melting matte / smooth matte / classic brownish red.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Non-drying” should be understood as the feel of the lipstick texture and its ability to help minimize flaking, not as treatment for dry lips. “Long-wearing” does not mean absolutely budge-proof after eating or drinking.

positioning.text: Slim matte lipstick in light beige brown, creating a soft, clean and modern nude lip color.

sellingPoints.text: Smooth matte formula that melts onto the lips; easy-to-wear light beige brown; can be layered to adjust intensity.

finish.text: Melting matte / soft matte nude / light beige brown.

claimDisclaimers.text: The nude shade may appear lighter or let natural lip color show through on dark lips. Do not claim it fully covers lip pigmentation.

positioning.text: Slim matte lipstick in light earthy pink, creating a soft, natural and refined lip color for everyday makeup.

sellingPoints.text: Smooth matte formula that melts onto the lips; easy-to-wear light earthy pink; light texture, layers without clumping.

finish.text: Melting matte / soft earthy pink / smooth matte.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually makes lips pinker. The light earthy pink shade may appear different depending on natural lip color.

positioning.text: Slim matte lipstick in beige-tinged coral pink, creating a lightly fresh, soft and easy-to-wear lip color.

sellingPoints.text: Smooth matte formula that melts onto the lips; beige-tinged coral pink that is fresh but not too bright; light texture, easy to layer.

finish.text: Melting matte / beige coral / soft matte.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually brightens skin. This is an effect of the lip color within the overall makeup look.

positioning.text: Slim matte lipstick in deep cool red, creating a deep, sharp and bold lip color.

sellingPoints.text: Smooth matte formula that melts onto the lips; deep cool red with depth; can be layered to build intensity without clumping.

finish.text: Melting matte / deep cool red / sharp matte.

claimDisclaimers.text: The deep cool red shade may appear different depending on natural lip color. Do not say it absolutely suits every skin tone.
